states: A readable guest and its metrics remain on screen with only its platform’s stale and unreachable source warnings.
No search matches: the compact result shows the existing text and count first, with both source warnings still visible.

Compare and inspect 24 matching PNGs at the same viewport, fixture values, theme, route and scroll position.
notes: Playwright 1.56.1. Exact committed Vite browser previews with a synthetic read-only estate. Not a native provider or embedded-backend check.
